parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description:
The cluster ID.
> You can call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~98094~~) operation to query the details of all clusters under your account, including the cluster ID.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page. Valid values: 
* **30**
* **50**
* **100**

Default value: **30**.
